statement: Pinned Linux consumer has a Pro-specific button mapping distinct from Joy-Con and maps left/right packed stick axes to ABS_X/Y and ABS_RX/RY and D-pad to ABS_HAT0X/Y. Consumer mapping names are not a universal native wire-label mapping.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: This maps Linux evdev semantics only; do not infer SDL or Steam spatial labels from kernel code alone.
